source.author: hor
source.text: nam vitiis nemo sine nascitur; optimus ille est, qui minimis urgetur.
source.text_original: nam vitiis nemo sine nascitur; optimus ille est,  / qui minimis urgetur.
source.text_english: for no one is born without faults; that man is best who is pressed by the fewest.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ceteris perturbationibus, quibus mens hominis gaudet, aegrescit, sperat et metuit, plures inuenio extraneos; hoc uitio pauci admodum sunt qui caruerint, et ille est optimus, qui quasi in pulchro corpore rara naeuorum sorde respergitur.
reuse.text_original: ceteris perturbationibus, quibus mens hominis gaudet, aegrescit, sperat et metuit, plures inuenio extraneos; hoc uitio pauci admodum sunt qui caruerint, et ille est optimus, qui quasi in pulchro corpore rara naeuorum sorde respergitur.
reuse.text_english: For the other disturbances by which the human mind rejoices, grows sick, hopes and fears, I find many more that are foreign to it; very few, indeed, have been free from this fault, and that man is the best who, like a beautiful body, is spotted here and there with the rare blemish of a few moles.
